hero.eyebrow: Family owned collision repair in Aiken
hero.title: Like it *never happened*
hero.lede: Certified collision repair and factory-matched paint on York Street. We work with your insurance company, set up your rental, and stand behind our work for as long as you own the car.

items.title: Collision repair
items.text: Major or minor damage, assessed carefully, including the damage you can’t see after a “small” accident.

items.title: Paint matching
items.text: Our painter matches your car’s exact color in the paint department, so the repair disappears.

items.title: Insurance claims
items.text: Direct Repair for State Farm and Nationwide, and part of Progressive’s Guaranteed Repair program.

items.title: Rental cars
items.text: We reserve your rental before drop-off, and Enterprise can pick you up right here at the shop.

items.title: Towing after hours
items.text: Call Keith’s Towing at (803) 663-3793. They can bring your car inside our gate even when we’re closed.

items.title: Free estimates
items.text: Book a time, use our online damage assessment, or call to talk with a repair specialist.

items.title: Free estimate
items.text: We go over your vehicle with you, answer your questions, and write up the repair.

items.title: Insurance and parts
items.text: We work directly with your insurer and preorder parts once you confirm your appointment.

items.title: A rental waiting
items.text: Your rental reservation is ready for drop-off day, and a ride home is available on request.

items.title: We call you
items.text: Certified technicians finish the work, and we call as soon as your car is ready.

sections.title: A family business *first*
body: Ross and Donna Smith bought Kelly Paint and Body in November 2006. Ross brings more than 35 years of management experience in the collision industry, and over 20 years of direct repair work for insurance companies.

Our promise is to keep you informed from start to finish, to train our people in honesty and integrity, and to have qualified, certified technicians on every repair. The shop has earned AutocheX Premier Achiever awards for customer satisfaction in 2012 and 2015, and an Aiken’s Choice award in 2018.
list: We donated a refurbished car to an Aiken veteran with State Farm through NABC Recycled Rides
We support Mothers Against Drunk Driving and the Special Olympics
Professional office staff to help with every claim

items.q: What warranty comes with the repair?
items.a: A limited lifetime warranty on our labor for as long as you own the car and maintain the paint. Parts are covered by their manufacturer, and stripes and decals for 3 years.

items.q: Can you match my paint color?
items.a: Yes. Our painter matches the color when your car goes to the paint department.

items.q: When do I pay my deductible?
items.a: If you have one, you pay it to us when you pick up your car.

items.q: What forms of payment do you accept?
items.a: MasterCard, Visa, Discover, insurance checks and cash.

items.q: When can I wash my car?
items.a: Wait six weeks: until then, no automatic car washes, dish detergent or hard soaps.

items.q: Can I get a ride home when I drop off?
